lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Dust kicks up on the county line
The sun sinks low in a copper sky
Just the hum of tires and the road
Watching the miles and the memories flow
[Chorus]
Down where the river meets the mud
Flowing steady like a pulse in the blood
Every bend tells a story untold
Turning the silver of the day into gold
[Verse]
A wooden stool and a whiskey glass
Watching the shadows of the evening pass
The neon sign hums a low steady tune
Under the gaze of a rising white moon
[Chorus]
Down where the river meets the mud
Flowing steady like a pulse in the blood
Every bend tells a story untold
Turning the silver of the day into gold
[Bridge]
The wind whispers secrets through the pines
Tracing the map of the heavy designs
[Chorus]
Down where the river meets the mud
Flowing steady like a pulse in the blood
Every bend tells a story untold
Turning the silver of the day into gold
[Outro]
